f1.coverageNote: The connected compiled F1 grid-sanction dataset begins in 2020. F1 race results and starting grids are available from 1950, but this project does not yet have a verified structured grid-penalty dataset for 1950–2019.

f2.label: Formula 2
f2.coverageNote: FIA decision-document archives were checked where reachable. An accessible season with no extracted grid sanctions is not proof that no penalties were issued; only explicit grid-drop, back-of-grid and pit-lane-start wording is recorded.
